thread:
tess: Heads up — webinar teaser going live tomorrow 10am PT. Need final X + LinkedIn copy, hero image, and the seedlist routing for SDRs. :rocket:

sam: Got it. Do we have a canonical CTA/UTM pattern? I can wire tracking if we lock it.

mara: Proposal: two CTAs — primary 'Register' and secondary 'Watch recording'. For UTMs use `?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=teaser_apr26&utm_medium=organic`

leo: Posting plan: X thread (3 tweets) at 10:00, follow-up reply at 10:15 with CTAs, LinkedIn single post 10:05. Who's building the 3-tweet cadence?

sasha: I can draft tweets. Need hero image + 30s clip. Also request A/B copy for the lead magnet (benchmark narrative vs. feature highlight).

tess: @sasha awesome — please put both copy options in a doc and tag me. Hero image in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz/marketing-heroes (final frame should be 1200x675).

sam: SDR routing: once someone registers, send lead to SFDC with lead_source = webinar_teaser and assign to team queue `SDR-Webinar-Pulse`. Confirming webhook mapping: events -> `/webhooks/marketing/registrations`

marketing-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for social publish at 2026-04-26T10:00:00Z — attendees: social leads, comms, SDR ops.

mara: Benchmark narrative quick note for copy: include one line on latency/cost improvements and one customer quote. Keep numbers high level (`~30% faster`, `~20% lower token cost`).

leo: For X thread structure: tweet1 = teaser headline + hero, tweet2 = 2 bullets (latency + cost) + link, tweet3 = CTA + registration link + clip. Add a pinned reply with FAQ.

sasha: Drafts posted here in 20m. Also asking design for two variants (dark/light) — @tess can you confirm priority?

tess: Prioritize dark for X, light for LinkedIn. Production deadline EOD today so we can QA tomorrow morning.

sam: Confirming UTM + webhook mapping. I'll add tracking to registration link and drop the final URL in this thread once published.

leo: Quick check on engagement follow-ups: plan for 1-hour and 24-hour reply windows. SDRs will get a Slack digest for new signups every 15m. Is that OK for ops? @sdr-team

sdr-team: Works for us. Please include lead intent score in webhook payload if possible.

mara: Also adding a short benchmark one-pager to the assets folder — use as swipe copy for replies.

tess: Thanks everyone. Action items: @sasha drafts (20m), @design final hero (3h), @sam adds UTM + webhook, @mara uploads benchmark one-pager, @leo schedules posts. We'll reconvene in #marketing at 9:15 PT tomorrow for quick QA. :white_check_mark:
